title: Tonogenesis in New Caledonia
notes: Consulted directly on 23 November 2026 (JSTOR PDF). High tone in Cèmuhî and Paicî (Centre North) and in Drubea, Numèè and Kwênyii (Far South) comes from aspirated consonants that already existed in Proto-Mainland, themselves from geminates produced by syllable reduplication (§§2-3, Figures 1-3).
